graph_loso.definition: leave-one-GRAPH-out per-graph pairwise accuracy (card question 2): training = all 36 strict pairs minus the held-out graph; each pair tested exactly once

newtopo_verdict.finding: ZERO decided pairs on the three training-unseen graphs: all 14 newtopo pairs were answered both-bad, so per-graph leave-one-graph-out pairwise accuracy on them is NOT MEASURABLE (n=0). anchor_vs_engine.definition: 9 asked human-anchor vs engine pairs (6 human-source candidates); model reading = out-of-fold margins from the stratum's LOSO evaluation (each pair tested exactly once; S_all folds train on 36-pair subsets, S_r3 folds on the 11 byte-faithful pairs); human_ranked_first = margin(human, engine) > 0

epsilon_calibration.definition: full-data calibration model per arm (trained on all 36 decided pairs; synthetic added only for the s-arms); tie margin = |model score difference (M0) or BT logit (BT arms)| over the 18 both-good pairs; epsilon initial value = P75 of that distribution.  The P75 value is an INITIAL calibration constant, not a validated threshold.
